## Project Overview

This sample project examines whether weather conditions and recurring seasonal patterns can predict daily urban bike ridership.

## Key Finding

The model captured the broad seasonal pattern, but prediction errors increased substantially during unusual weather events.

## Methods

- Time-series exploration
- Seasonal regression
- Prediction-error analysis
- Data visualization
